title: Is Lower Vision-SAE Sparsity an Artifact of Patch-Token Redundancy?

original_idea.body: Measure pre-trained vision SAE L0/firing on natural, spatially-shuffled, and noise images to test whether patch redundancy drives vision-SAE density; pure inference.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Explaining vision-SAE density is basic science with only a vague, distant link to catastrophic AI risk (level 2).

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Pre-trained SAE inference on natural/shuffled/noise images; accessible (level 5).

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Open weights, no training, externally runnable (level 4).

low_compute.reasoning: Pure inference on open weights, no GPU training.

novelty.reasoning: Patch-redundancy causal explanation described as untested; mostly novel.
